info.title: Flashquotes API
info.description: API for accessing quote, event, form, and invoice data from Flashquotes

get.description: Paginated list of events for your company, newest first. Supports range filters on service_start_time and created_at, equality filters on location_id and booking_id, cursor pagination, and inline expansion of related objects via expand[].

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Default 10, maximum 100.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Cursor — the id of the last event from the previous page.

parameters.name: service_start_time[gt]
parameters.description: Events whose service_start_time is strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime (must include timezone, e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z).

parameters.name: service_start_time[gte]
parameters.description: Events whose service_start_time is at or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: service_start_time[lt]
parameters.description: Events whose service_start_time is strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: service_start_time[lte]
parameters.description: Events whose service_start_time is at or before this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: created_at[gt]
parameters.description: Events created strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: created_at[gte]
parameters.description: Events created at or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: created_at[lt]
parameters.description: Events created strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: created_at[lte]
parameters.description: Events created at or before this ISO 8601 datetime.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Filter to events at this location.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: Filter to events on this booking.

parameters.name: expand[]
parameters.description: Inline related objects. On list endpoints each path must be prefixed with `data.` (e.g. `data.booking.lead`). Allow-listed paths: data.location, data.services, data.staff, data.addons, data.resources, data.booking, data.booking.lead, data.booking.eventType, data.booking.invoices. Max 20 paths, max depth 4.

400.description: Invalid query parameter (limit, date format, or expand path)

error.message: limit must be an integer between 1 and 100
service_start_time[gte] must be a valid ISO 8601 date

InvalidExpand.summary: Missing data. prefix on list endpoint

error.message: expand path 'booking.lead' must be prefixed with 'data.' on list endpoints
Unauthorized, invalid or missing API key

get.description: Retrieve a single event by id. By default returns the event's own scalar fields and foreign-key ids; pass expand[] to inline related objects.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event id.

parameters.name: expand[]
parameters.description: Inline related objects. Allow-listed paths: location, services, staff, addons, resources, booking, booking.lead, booking.eventType, booking.invoices. Requesting any `booking.*` path auto-promotes `booking`. Max 20 paths, max depth 4.

error.message: Unknown expand path: 'booking.foo'
Unauthorized, invalid or missing API key
Event not found

get.description: Paginated list of resources for your company, newest first. Supports an equality filter on location_id and cursor pagination. Resources have no expandable relations — any expand[] value returns 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Default 10, maximum 100.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Cursor — the id of the last resource from the previous page.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Filter to resources at this location.

data.name: Espresso Cart
data.description: Mobile espresso bar with barista station

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event

get.description: Retrieve a single staff member by id. Scoped to the API key's company: unknown ids and ids belonging to another company both return 404. Retrieve does not filter by status, so inactive staff resolve directly by id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The staff id.

parameters.name: expand[]
parameters.description: Reserved for future use. No expand paths are supported on staff yet — passing any value returns 400.

400.description: Invalid expand path (no expand paths are currently supported on staff)

get.description: Retrieve a quote summary with live totalPriceCents. Requires an x-api-key with public API access (Scale, or eligible Grandfathered Pro). Related objects are returned only when requested through expand[].

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Quote ID.

parameters.name: expand[]
parameters.description: Use paths without a data. prefix. Repeat expand[] or use comma-separated paths. A nested path includes its parents; unrequested siblings stay absent. Maximum 20 distinct paths per request and four segments, excluding data. Unknown or malformed paths return 400. Allowed paths: lead, location, eventType, services, addons, discounts, taxRate, paymentTerms, serviceCharges, serviceDays, contract, booking, booking.lead, booking.eventType, booking.invoices, booking.events, booking.events.location, booking.events.services, booking.events.staff, booking.events.addons, booking.events.resources, booking.events.booking, booking.events.booking.lead, booking.events.booking.eventType, booking.events.booking.invoices, booking.events.booking.events.

400.description: Invalid expansion path or expansion limit exceeded.

error.message: Unknown expand path: 'lineItems'

401.description: Authentication denied: missing or invalid API key, disallowed IP, or plan without public API access.

error.message: Unauthorized, invalid or missing API key
Internal server error
Authentication service unavailable

404.description: Quote not found, deleted, or inaccessible to your company.

error.message: Quote not found

get.description: List quote summaries for your company with live totals, equality and date-range filters, cursor pagination, and optional related-object expansions. Requires public API access (Scale, or eligible Grandfathered Pro). Results are ordered by createdAt descending, then id descending; sort order is fixed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: ID of the last quote in the previous page. The cursor must be accessible and match all supplied filters; otherwise the response is an empty page with hasMore false. Keep filters unchanged between pages.

parameters.name: lead_id
parameters.description: Filter by exact contact ID.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Filter by exact location ID.

parameters.name: booking_id
parameters.description: Filter by exact booking ID.

parameters.name: event_type_id
parameters.description: Filter by exact event type ID.

parameters.name: created_at[gt]
parameters.description: Filter quote creation time: strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: created_at[gte]
parameters.description: Filter quote creation time: at or after this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: created_at[lt]
parameters.description: Filter quote creation time: strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: created_at[lte]
parameters.description: Filter quote creation time: at or before this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: updated_at[gt]
parameters.description: Filter quote row update time (not a complete financial change feed): strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: updated_at[gte]
parameters.description: Filter quote row update time (not a complete financial change feed): at or after this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: updated_at[lt]
parameters.description: Filter quote row update time (not a complete financial change feed): strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: updated_at[lte]
parameters.description: Filter quote row update time (not a complete financial change feed): at or before this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: service_start_time[gt]
parameters.description: Filter service-day start time; at least one day must satisfy all supplied bounds: strictly after this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: service_start_time[gte]
parameters.description: Filter service-day start time; at least one day must satisfy all supplied bounds: at or after this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: service_start_time[lt]
parameters.description: Filter service-day start time; at least one day must satisfy all supplied bounds: strictly before this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: service_start_time[lte]
parameters.description: Filter service-day start time; at least one day must satisfy all supplied bounds: at or before this ISO 8601 datetime. Include a timezone (Z or ±HH:MM); bare dates are rejected.

parameters.name: expand[]
parameters.description: Every path must start with data. Repeat expand[] or use comma-separated paths. A nested path includes its parents; unrequested siblings stay absent. Maximum 20 distinct paths per request and four segments, excluding data. Unknown or malformed paths return 400. Allowed paths: data.lead, data.location, data.eventType, data.services, data.addons, data.discounts, data.taxRate, data.paymentTerms, data.serviceCharges, data.serviceDays, data.contract, data.booking, data.booking.lead, data.booking.eventType, data.booking.invoices, data.booking.events, data.booking.events.location, data.booking.events.services, data.booking.events.staff, data.booking.events.addons, data.booking.events.resources, data.booking.events.booking, data.booking.events.booking.lead, data.booking.events.booking.eventType, data.booking.events.booking.invoices, data.booking.events.booking.events.

hasMore.description: Whether more pages are available. If true, use the id of the last item in `data` as `starting_after` to fetch the next page.

Event.description: Default response includes only the fields below plus foreign-key ids (bookingId, locationId, eventBriefId). Related objects (location, services, staff, addons, resources, booking) appear only when requested via expand[].

example.name: Acme launch party
example.additionalLocationInfo: Load in via rear loading dock
example.specialNotes: No nuts in any service items

eventBriefUrl.description: Public URL to view the event brief, or null if no brief exists.

customData.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata attached to the event.

booking.description: Present only when expanded (auto-promoted by any `booking.*` expand).

status.description: Staff status. Retrieve returns members regardless of status; inactive staff resolve directly by id.

Resource.description: Default response includes all fields below. Resources have no expandable relations.

data.name: Espresso Cart
data.description: Mobile espresso bar with barista station

hasMore.description: Whether more pages are available. If true, use the id of the last item in `data` as `starting_after` to fetch the next page.

lead.description: Present only when lead is expanded on this booking. Returns null when missing or inaccessible.

eventType.description: Present only when eventType is expanded on this booking. Returns null when missing or inaccessible.

invoices.description: Present only when invoices is expanded on this booking. Terminal invoice summaries; deeper invoice expansions and line items are not supported.

events.description: Present only when events is expanded on this booking. Ordered by serviceStartTime ascending, then id ascending.

source.description: The contact's recorded lead source. Returns null when no source is set. Included wherever a lead object is expanded.

Invoice.description: Slim invoice shape used everywhere invoices appear in the public API.

url.description: Encrypted public URL to view the invoice.

status.description: Computed invoice status (e.g. Draft, Open, Paid, Overdue, PartiallyPaid).

total.description: Total amount in the smallest currency unit (cents).

amountPaid.description: Amount paid excluding failed payments, in cents.

error.message: limit must be an integer between 1 and 100

param.description: Name of the offending parameter, when applicable.

LegacyEvent.description: Legacy event shape returned by GET /event/getEventData/{event_id}.

eventBriefUrl.description: URL to access the event brief

LegacyEventSummary.description: Legacy event summary shape returned by GET /event/get-events.

FormResponse.description: Flattened object with question titles as keys and answers as values

LegacyInvoice.description: Legacy invoice shape returned by GET /invoice/{booking_id}.

invoiceUrl.description: Encrypted URL to view the invoice

bookingPaymentStatus.description: Overall payment status across all invoices for this booking

updatedAt.description: When the quote row was last updated. Child pricing changes can change totalPriceCents without changing this timestamp.

sentAt.description: When the quote was sent, or null.

bookedAt.description: When the quote was booked, or null.

lostAt.description: When the quote was marked lost, or null.

lostReason.description: Reason the quote was marked lost, or null.

leadId.description: Contact ID. The related object is named lead in the API.

discountId.description: Quote-level discount ID, or null. The discounts expansion also includes line-level discount definitions.

siteContactPhone.description: On-site contact phone number, or null.

totalPriceCents.description: Live overall quote total in the currency’s minor units (cents for USD), recalculated on every request from saved pricing, fees, discounts, service charges, and tax. Excludes booking-time gratuity; not an unpaid invoice balance. Expansion does not change this value.

lead.description: Present only when `lead` is expanded (use `data.lead` on lists). Returns null when the relation is missing or inaccessible.

location.description: Present only when `location` is expanded (use `data.location` on lists). Returns null when the relation is missing or inaccessible.

eventType.description: Present only when `eventType` is expanded (use `data.eventType` on lists). Returns null when the relation is missing or inaccessible.

services.description: Present only when `services` is expanded (use `data.services` on lists). Returns [] when empty. Distinct current line-item service definitions. Archived services are omitted; saved prices still contribute to the total.

addons.description: Present only when `addons` is expanded (use `data.addons` on lists). Returns [] when empty. Distinct current line-item add-on definitions, without unit prices. Archived add-ons are omitted; saved prices still contribute to the total.

discounts.description: Present only when `discounts` is expanded (use `data.discounts` on lists). Returns [] when empty. Deduplicated quote-level and line-level definitions, with the quote-level definition first. No allocations or realized discount amounts. Attached archived definitions remain visible.

taxRate.description: Present only when `taxRate` is expanded (use `data.taxRate` on lists). Returns null when the relation is missing or inaccessible.

paymentTerms.description: Present only when `paymentTerms` is expanded (use `data.paymentTerms` on lists). Returns null when the relation is missing or inaccessible.

serviceCharges.description: Present only when `serviceCharges` is expanded (use `data.serviceCharges` on lists). Returns [] when empty. Flat definition array without association wrappers or calculated charge amounts. Attached archived definitions remain visible.

serviceDays.description: Present only when `serviceDays` is expanded (use `data.serviceDays` on lists). Returns [] when empty. Flat array ordered by serviceStartTime ascending, then id ascending.

contract.description: Present only when `contract` is expanded (use `data.contract` on lists). Returns null when the relation is missing or inaccessible. Template metadata only; excludes contract content and signatures.

booking.description: Present only when `booking` is expanded (use `data.booking` on lists). Returns null when the relation is missing or inaccessible.

Quote.description: Quote summary with live overall value. Base fields are always present; nullable native values remain null. Relations appear only when expanded. Quote and invoice line items, quantities, unit prices, and pricing configuration are not exposed.

amountOff.description: Fixed discount in minor currency units, or null.

rate.description: Tax rate as a fraction (0.0825 means 8.25%).

depositAmountCents.description: Fixed deposit amount in minor currency units.

percentageValue.description: Percentage charge as a fraction (0.15 means 15%), or null.

amountCents.description: Fixed charge in minor currency units, or null.

hasMore.description: Whether more pages exist. Pass the last returned quote ID as starting_after to retrieve the next page.
